description: Write component substitutions or stage an intake draft. Use it when connecting React/Vue exports, shadcn source or built Storybook files; use component_map_read to list, resolve or review drafts. Returns staged evidence or write outcomes. apply with draftId requires accepted ids and writes adapters and mappings atomically. create takes one entry, mappings or mappingsPath; create and report-based apply preview unless apply:true. update and delete always write. Full schema: oods://schemas/component_map.input.json.

action.description: Choose apply, create, update, delete, draft.

apply.description: For apply: When true, persist registry mutations. Defaults to dry-run. For create: When true, write changes to disk. Actions: apply, create.

capabilities.description: Capability definitions to append. Actions: create.

confidence.description: 'auto' for machine-generated, 'manual' for human-curated. Actions: create.

disambiguation_decisions.description: Review decisions to append; does not gate creation. Actions: create.

externalSystem.description: External design system name (for example, 'team'). Actions: create, draft.

mappings.description: Create entries, each without apply. All entries are checked before one atomic write. Actions: create.

items.description: A single-create payload without action or apply; the handler checks every value against… See full schema for details.

mappingsPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON document { mappings: [...] }, using the same entry shape. Actions: create.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence to apply; lower candidates are queued. Actions: apply.

oodsTraits.description: OODS trait names this component maps to. Actions: create.

preferred_terms.description: Canonical terms to append. Actions: create.

projection_variants.description: Cross-surface mapping variants to append. Actions: create.

propMappings.description: Property translations from external to OODS prop names. Actions: create.

items.description: prop Mappings item. Fields: externalProp, oodsProp, coercion. See full schema.

reportPath.description: Filesystem path to a reconciliation_report.json artifact. Actions: apply.

substitution.description: Component substitution with React/Vue exports and prop translations. Actions: create.

component.description: The shipped OODS Foundry component id being replaced.

react.description: react. Fields: localPath, package, export, version, passthrough, props, shadcn. See full schema.

vue.description: vue. Fields: localPath, package, export, version, passthrough, props, shadcn. See full schema.

updates.description: Fields to change: oodsTraits, confidence, propMappings, metadata, substitution. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Actions: update (required).

name: component_map
title: Write Component Mappings
